probes.name: replace_after_run
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object, other As Object, first As Long
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Function Answer() As Long" & vbCrLf & "Answer = 1" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
first = Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Helpers.Answer")
part.CodeModule.ReplaceLine 2, "Answer = 3"
Probe = CStr(Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Helpers.Answer"))
target.Close False
End Function

probes.name: replace_then_insert

Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object, other As Object, first As Long
Application.EnableEvents = False

Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)

probes.name: replace_after_other_module
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object, other As Object, first As Long
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Function Answer() As Long" & vbCrLf & "Answer = 1" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
Set other = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
other.Name = "Other"
other.CodeModule.AddFromString "Function Answer() As Long" & vbCrLf & "Answer = 9" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
first = Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Other.Answer")
part.CodeModule.ReplaceLine 2, "Answer = 3"
Probe = CStr(Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Helpers.Answer"))
target.Close False
End Function
